### 🕹️ Skyblock Realm Player Move

> **Click the green "Create" button below to execute this move!**

The automated Skyblock game engine will:
1. 🎮 Process your move or crafting action.
2. 🎨 Re-render the 3D isometric island SVG in real time.
3. 📦 Update Steve's inventory and close this issue automatically in ~15 seconds.
